construct.name: opponent-roster-dependent strategy ranking and non-transitive dominance
construct.intended_use: Verify roster-conditional scores, directed dominance cycles, rank correlation and a prediction-error regret certificate on exact rock-paper-scissors payoffs.
construct.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 exact synthetic RPS reference only; no 54-agent empirical reproduction or model leaderboard claim.

units.independent_unit: One exact deterministic payoff matrix and four named rosters
units.dependence_statement: All roster outcomes are derived from the same deterministic payoff matrix; roster contrasts are designed scenarios, not independent samples.

sources.missingness_semantics: The deterministic fixture has complete declared cells; absent cells are missing/unsupported, never zero.

evaluation_distribution.sampling_frame: Three strategies evaluated against four fixed 30-opponent rosters: balanced, rock-heavy, paper-heavy and scissors-heavy.

factors.weight_interpretation: Four designed stress-test rosters; not opponent population prevalence.
Three symmetric actions in the exact reference game.

perturbation_families.rationale: Changes the composition of the evaluation roster while keeping payoff matrix and strategy set fixed.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Recompute expected payoff and rank under every explicit roster and detect the known RPS cycle.
expected_invariants: Every roster is identified on every reported score.
Balanced roster has equal expected payoffs.
Each skewed roster favors the counter-strategy.
perturbation_families.seed_policy: Exact deterministic enumeration; no stochastic seed.

replication_design.independent_unit: One fixed deterministic design matrix; no stochastic or empirical replication is claimed.
replication_design.dependence_assessment: Scenario, strategy, participant and condition cells are deterministic benchmark fixtures, not independent draws from a target population.
replication_design.sample_size_rationale: One deterministic execution is sufficient to verify exact code paths and negative controls; it cannot support confidence intervals or population inference.

metrics.aggregation: expected payoff against the exact declared opponent mixture
best response payoff minus strategy payoff for the same roster
directed three-cycle count in the payoff dominance graph
average-rank Spearman correlation; undefined for constant rankings

metrics.construct_dimension: bounded regret from opponent-distribution prediction error
metrics.aggregation: payoff range multiplied by L1 opponent-distribution error; actual regret retained separately

baselines.description: Enumerated best response against the declared opponent distribution.

negative_controls.intervention: Use exact cyclic RPS payoff matrix.
negative_controls.expected_result: Exactly one oriented three-strategy cycle is detected.

negative_controls.intervention: Change opponent roster from rock-heavy to paper-heavy.
negative_controls.expected_result: Winning strategy changes from paper to scissors; balanced ranking correlation remains undefined where all payoffs tie.

negative_controls.intervention: Use actual opponent distribution [0.1,0.8,0.1] and predicted [0.8,0.1,0.1].
negative_controls.expected_result: Actual best-response regret is 0.7 and certificate upper bound is 2.8.

holdouts.leakage_control: No empirical rows are used; this reference supports no external-generalization claim.

reproduction.configuration_digest: civdyn-opponent-roster-v0.1; 3×3 exact RPS payoff; 4 fixed 30-opponent rosters
reproduction.runtime_environment: Rust edition 2024; deterministic benchmark crate; exact-head GitHub Actions workflow
reproduction.humanity_atlas_run_artifact_ref: Not applicable: synthetic benchmark reference execution; no full Humanity Atlas scenario artifact is claimed.

claim_report.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 exact synthetic RPS reference only; no 54-agent empirical reproduction or model leaderboard claim.
known_limitations: RPS is an artificial exact control, not an empirical social or strategic game.
No stochastic tournament, adaptation, memory, learning or model latency is evaluated.
The regret certificate uses the full payoff-range bound and is not an empirical confidence interval.
unsupported_strata: Real-world multi-agent model populations, non-RPS tasks, learned policies and empirically estimated payoff matrices.
